about_the_game:
2019 broke the world.

The K-98 outbreak turned cities and farmlands into hostile hunting grounds. DeadLived is a multiplayer-only open-world survival looter-shooter where infected (zombies) and players collide.

The world of DeadLived

When the K-98 virus spread, 90% of humanity perished within months. The rest rose again, driven by hunger and instinct. Only a fraction proved mysteriously immune, these survivors became the last fragile thread of civilization.

The remnants of the UWS (United West States) still cling to control, while territories like Guntario and Pelvico are overrun by infected, raiders and outlaws. In this broken world, every survivor writes their own story: will you fight to rebuild, or embrace chaos for power?

But the land remembers. Every ruin hides a story from abandoned houses to military bunkers, the world is scattered with hundreds of hidden side tales waiting to be uncovered by those who dare to explore.

What makes DeadLived different

  • Safe Zones — guarded hubs with stash, traders, quest boards and crafters to prepare your next run.

  • Karma System — reputation (Guardian / Neutral / Outlaw) shapes access, shop prices, NPC reactions and bounties.

  • Player Trading — secure P2P trades with dual confirmation, taxes, and local flea markets.

  • Quests & Contracts — faction missions, bounty hunts, escort runs and dynamic world events.

  • PvE × PvP Tension — infected roam the world while players fight over the same loot.

  • Two Perspectives — play in both first and third person.

  • Three Progression Paths — PvE, PvP and Survival skills evolving together.

  • Seasons & Weather — a living climate system where rain, storms, snow and heat impact stamina, visibility, noise and survival choices.

  • Survival Core — manage hunger, thirst and stamina as you explore, fight and scavenge.

  • Immersive World — powered by Unreal Engine, with dynamic day/night cycles and high-fidelity visuals.

A world driven by players

The infected may dominate the ruins, but the true danger and the true story comes from players. Every run is unpredictable: alliances form, betrayals cut deep, and your reputation follows you. DeadLived is built to be shaped by its community, and we will actively listen and ask for feedback throughout development.

Survival is never guaranteed

- Scavenge abandoned ruins, rural fields and devastated UWS outposts.

- Reach the safezone alive, or become someone else’s loot.

- Choose to cooperate, betray, or be hunted.

Some featues are still in development and may evolve during production.

Add  DeadLived to your wishlist to follow progress, join the community, and help us shape the future of survival.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent violence, blood, gore and disturbing imagery, including realistic injuries and grotesque infected creatures.  
Horror themes and tense survival scenarios may be frightening to some players.  
The game also features the use of alcohol and medical drugs as part of its survival mechanics.  
No sexual content or nudity is present.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements subject to change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-core 4.0 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements subject to change during development.

short_description: DeadLived is a multiplayer-only open-world survival looter-shooter where infected (zombies) and players collide for the same loot. Seasons, weather and survival needs shape every choice. Trust, betray, or be hunted, the community itself brings this world to life.
